pupLagoon.how.step1.title: 1. Your baon
pupLagoon.how.step1.text: You get a set amount of money for this vacant.

pupLagoon.how.step4.title: 4. Don't go over!

pupLagoon.guide.intro: This is your listahan (right). Buy food for every line without spending more than your baon. I'll show you how!
pupLagoon.guide.tab: First, go to {stall}: tap its tab at the top.
pupLagoon.guide.card: Tap {food} to put it on your tray.
pupLagoon.guide.cardSauce: Tap {food}, then choose {sauce} as the sawsawan.
pupLagoon.guide.closeSauce: We don't need this one. Close it with x.
pupLagoon.guide.fix: That one is not on your listahan. Tap it in your tray to put it back.
pupLagoon.guide.bayad: Your tray is ready. Tap Bayad to pay.
pupLagoon.guide.place: Tap your coins and bills until you place at least ₱{total}. Smart pay picks them for you.
pupLagoon.guide.heto: That's enough! Tap Heto po! to pay.
pupLagoon.guide.sukli: Your sukli is ₱{change}. It went back into your wallet (bottom right).
pupLagoon.guide.wait: The grill is still going. Wait a moment...
pupLagoon.guide.eat: Your listahan is complete! Tap Kain na! to finish the round.
pupLagoon.guide.offPlan: You're doing it your way! Remember: buy every line on your listahan, don't go over your baon, then tap Kain na!.
